english.title: Engage in conduct likely to materially assist a designated body to carry out UK related activities
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17B(2) and (9) of the National Security Act 2023.

english.notes:
(i) Conduct that may be likely to materially assist a designated body includes providing, or providing access to, information, goods, services or financial benefits (whether directly or indirectly) (section 17B(3)).
(ii) “UK-related activities” means activities taking place in the United Kingdom; activities taking place outside the United Kingdom which are prejudicial to the safety or interests of the United Kingdom (section 17B(4)).(iii) This offence applies to conduct outside the United Kingdom, but only if the person engaging in the conduct is a UK person, or acts for or on behalf of, or holds office under, the Crown, or is in Crown employment (whether or not they engage in the conduct in that capacity).
(iv) A person will have a defence for this offence where they can show they engaged in the conduct in question for certain purposes, see section 17B(6), (7) and (8). (v) Additional powers of entry, search and seizure are provided in Schedule 2 where there are reasonable grounds for suspecting that this offence has been, or is about to be, committed.
(vi) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Attorney General, section 37 of the National Security Act 2023.
